# Psalm 92 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 92:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** A-psalm. A-song for-the-day-of the-Sabbath. Good to-give-thanks to-YHWH, and-to-sing-praises to-your-name O-Most-High,
- **LOGOS:** A Psalm. A Song for the Sabbath. It is good to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, O Most High;
- **PNEUMA:** A psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It's wonderful to thank the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High God!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **PNEUMA:** It's wonderful to announce your faithful love every morning and proclaim your reliability every night,

## 92:7 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** When-sprout the-wicked like-grass, and-flourish all doers-of iniquity — it-is to-be-destroyed-them forever.
- **LOGOS:** that though the wicked sprout like grass and all evildoers flourish, they are doomed to destruction forever.
- **PNEUMA:** Even though the wicked pop up like weeds and evildoers seem to thrive — they're headed for eternal destruction.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
